== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and later English Errata articles for [[Tentacle]]. Columns are Original · PC Errata (2018 E) · PC Errata 2 (Appendix A). Glossary 2.0 is a ruling, not a Decipher Errata column. Counterpart dest: [[Grappling Hook]]. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Revised, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per real Errata face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
